items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart suffered sprained MCL (X-rays negative, MRI Tue); expected to miss some time. Officially ruled out of MNF; wanted to return but stayed out.
items.why: Knee injury on big hit; initial exams sprained MCL, positive news relatively.
items.implication: Jameis Winston in; miss time ahead.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players adjust.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants.
items.why: Did not practice Fri/Sat; trending wrong way pregame.
items.implication: Davante Adams featured; secondary WRs and TEs elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Adams and depth WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signed Zach Ertz to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: MRI confirmed sprained MCL; left mid-game.
items.implication: Multi-week absence; Ertz reunion for depth.
items.opportunity: TE snaps/targets to Mundt/Jenkins/Ertz; WRs may benefit.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) underwent imaging; consulting specialists next days per protocol. Mariota expected to start vs SEA; no timeline, out indefinitely.
items.why: Repeat dislocation (no fracture on X-ray); further eval for ligaments/surgery.
items.implication: Mariota starts short-term; Daniels miss time.
items.opportunity: Backup QB role; skill players less dual-threat.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers questionable to return (shoulder) then returned to MNF.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; rehab over surgery, out several weeks (IR likely), possible midseason return. Surgery still possible.
With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Pivot Parkinson if flex open; else WR Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams (hamstring) week-to-week, expects miss some time after MRI. Same hamstring as prior college injury. Bagent backup.
Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving lead back emerging; Gainwell limited.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished in playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches possible.
items.why: Fumble punishment + weapon-deficient offense needs Henderson.
items.opportunity: Henderson touches/routes up with Brown out.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps, 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.

Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (disloc elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), Aaron Jones (knee), JK Dobbins (ham), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), Njoku/Kolar etc.
